title: AI Red Teaming Agent Training Pack
source_basis: 11 user-provided OffSec AI-300 / OSAI+ module documents and the previously prepared compendium

modules.title: Introduction to Red Teaming AI Systems
modules.coverage: AI security landscape, AI-specific risks, business impact, responsible testing, frameworks and engagement lifecycle.

modules.title: Reconnaissance for AI Targets
modules.coverage: AI architecture mapping, passive and active reconnaissance, HTTP fingerprinting, repository mining, service discovery, model fingerprinting, RAG discovery, telemetry and detection analysis.

modules.title: Attacking AI Agents
modules.coverage: Single-agent architecture, direct and indirect prompt injection, system prompt extraction, goal hijacking, document/web/code injection, memory poisoning and cross-session leakage.

modules.title: Attacking Multi-Agent Systems and A2A
modules.coverage: Coordination patterns, trust boundaries, A2A discovery, Agent Cards, OpenAPI, workflow observation, workflow integrity, output manipulation, rogue agent registration, agent-card spoofing and data poisoning.

modules.title: Exploiting RAG Pipelines
modules.coverage: RAG ingestion/retrieval, knowledge-base leakage, ingestion poisoning, embedding collision, retrieval hijacking, encodings/substitution, document blending and slow-drip poisoning.

modules.title: Attacking Embeddings
modules.coverage: Vector exposure, embedding model identification, chunk triage, zero-shot inversion, template-based inversion, beam search, membership inference, ALGEN/canaries and Vec2Text.

modules.title: Attacking MCP and Tool Surfaces
modules.coverage: MCP architecture/transports, tool/schema enumeration, description poisoning, MCP Apps UI spoofing, over-privileged servers, filesystem/parameter bypass, tool chaining and capstone reasoning.

modules.title: Supply Chain Attacks on AI/ML Systems
modules.coverage: MCP and dependency risks, unsafe pickle deserialization, training-data poisoning, adapter/LoRA poisoning, tokenizer manipulation, scanner evasion and backdoor considerations.

modules.title: AI Infrastructure and Deployment Exploits
modules.coverage: Cloud IAM weaknesses, secrets, exposed endpoints/data stores, Kubernetes RBAC, identity chaining, multi-container pods and container security.

modules.title: Threat Modeling for AI-Enabled Targets
modules.coverage: Partial intelligence, assumption registers, active recon, evolving architecture, crown jewels, ATLAS mapping, trust zones, escalation paths and intelligence briefs.

modules.title: Assembling the Pieces — Capstone Red Team Engagement
modules.coverage: Integrated enterprise capstone: public web/AI entry points, backend data paths, RDS gateway, internal enumeration, share discovery, module hijack, credential exposure and AD impact. The uploaded capstone is an enterprise network/AD scenario, not solely an AI scenario.

record_format: JSONL; one technique card per line; UTF-8
safety_note: Examples are synthetic, local, read-only or dry-run. Source lab secrets and weaponised operational sequences are not included.
